issue_context.body:
# Bug report - supabase dashboard

- [x] I confirm this is a bug with Supabase, not with my own application. 
- [x] I confirm I have searched the [Docs](https://docs.supabase.com), GitHub [Discussions](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions), and [Discord](https://discord.supabase.com). 

## Describe the bug

When scrolling with the [project page's](https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_) sidebar you'll get confusing behaviour of the layout - something's wrong with the positioning of the logo.
Such a small thing, yet so annoying.

## To Reproduce

1. Go to [a project in the dashboard](https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_)
2. Scroll a bit with the side bar

## Expected behavior

Good ux, no problems with the position of elements.

## Screenshots

![ss1](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/assets/151644171/e82fe684-0fdd-490c-8143-8021ef199449)
![ss2](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/assets/151644171/bf5b4d34-4988-494b-9b4c-a3a6b21b0a5e)
![ss3](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/assets/151644171/610c79bd-9340-4df4-9e3e-26c45e7678b0)

## System information

- Browser: chrome
